# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest tagged release is supported for security fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for suspected security vulnerabilities.

Instead, report the issue privately to the maintainers through GitHub Security Advisories or direct maintainer contact if one is listed in the repository profile.

Include:

- A description of the issue and affected component
- Reproduction steps or proof of concept
- Impact assessment
- Any known mitigations

Maintainers should acknowledge receipt within 7 days and provide a follow-up status update after triage.
